chunks: Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim asked him about a man who travels with his wife and she dies: should he wash her? He said:
"Yes, and his mother, his sister, and those like them. He places a cloth over her private parts and washes her."

key_terms.خِرْقَةً: a cloth used here to cover the private area
key_terms.عَوْرَتِهَا: her private parts that must be covered
key_terms.نَحْوَهُمَا: others similar to them among close female relatives
key_terms.يُغَسِّلُهَا: he performs the ritual washing of her deceased body

ai.seo_question: Can a man perform the ritual washing of his deceased wife or close female relative?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the ghusl of a deceased woman by a close male relative in a circumstance of need. It permits the washing while requiring that her private area be covered with a cloth, showing concern for both funerary duty and modesty.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.430 - Mansour ibn Hazim asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a man traveling with his wife, and She dies. Should he wash her?
Imam (as) replied: "Yes, as well as his mother, sister, and similar relatives. He should cover her private parts with a cloth and then perform the washing."
